English: Understanding ecology of microbiomes in drinking water distribution systems is the most important notion in delivering safe drinking water.

Yoruba: Níní òye nípa ìbáṣepọ̀ àwọn ohun abẹ̀mí aláìfojúrí nínú ètò ìpínká omi mímu jẹ́ pàtàkì nípa ṣíṣẹ èto ìpínkáàkiri omi tó dára fún mímu.
Zulu: Ukuqonda i-ecology yama-microbiomes ezinhlelweni zokusabalalisa amanzi okuphuza kuwumbono obaluleke kakhulu ekuletheni amanzi okuphuza aphephile.
Hausa: Fahimtar ilimin halittu na ‘yan halitta a cikin tsarin rarraba ruwan sha shi ne mafi mahimmancin ra’ayi a cikin isar da tsaftataccen ruwan sha.
Northern Sotho: Go kwešiša phedišano ya diphedinyana lefelong le itšego ka mananeong a kabo ya meetse a go nwewa ke selo se bohlokwa kudu ka kabong ya meetse a go nwewa ao a bolokegilego.
Amharic: በመጠጥ ውሃ ስርጭት ስርዓቶች ውስጥ የማይክሮባዮሞችን ስነ-ምህዳር መረዳት ንፁህ የመጠጥ ውሃን ለማዳረስ እጅግ አስፈላጊው ሃሳብ ነው።

English: Despite cultivation-based methods routinely employed in monitoring drinking water quality, cultivation of specific indicator organisms alone is not always guarantee for assuring safe drinking water delivery.
Luganda: Newankubadde ng’enkola z’obulimi zikozeseddwa nnyo mu kulondoola kulondoola omutindo gw’amazzi g’okunywa, okulunda obuwuka obumu obukozesebwa okuzuula obuwuka bw’omu mazzi kyokka tekumala kukakasa buli kaseera nti wajja kubaawo amazzi g’okunywa amalungi.
Yoruba: Pẹ̀lú ìlànà adálórí-ìkọbẹ̀ tí a ṣàmúlò fún mímójútó àmúyẹ omi mímu, kíkọ irúfẹ́ àwọn ohun abẹ̀mí kan nìkan ní pàtó kò fi àrídájú múlẹ̀ fún ìfinilọ́kànle ìpínká omi mímu tó dára.
Zulu: Naphezu kwezindlela ezisekelwe ekulimeni ezisetshenziswa njalo ekuqapheni izinga lamanzi okuphuza, ukutshalwa kwezinto eziphilayo eziyinkomba kukodwa akusona isiqinisekiso ngaso sonke isikhathi sokuqinisekisa ukulethwa kwamanzi okuphuza aphephile.
Hausa: Duk da hanyoyin noma da ake amfani da su akai-akai wajen lura da ingancin ruwan sha, noman takamaiman manunin ƙwayoyin halitta kaɗai ba koyaushe yake da garantin tabbatar da isar da ruwan sha mai tsafta ba.
Northern Sotho: Ka ntle le mekgwa ya go bjala yeo e šomišwago ka sewelo ge go hlokometšwe boleng bja meetse a go nwewa, go diriša selaetši se itšego fela sa go laetša diphedinyana tša ka meetseng ka mehla ga se tiišetšo ya go netefatša gore go abja meetse a go nwewa ao a bolokegilego.

English: The presence of complex microbiomes in drinking water distribution systems affects treatment effectiveness leading to poor quality water which as a result affects health of human and animals.
Luganda: Okubaawo kw’obuwuka obutinniinya mu miyungo egitambuza amazzi g’okunywa kikosa obutuukamu bw’okugalongoosa ne kiviirako okubeera n’amazzi ag’omutindo omubi olwo ate nakyo ne kikosa obulamu bw’abantu n’ensolo.
Yoruba: Ìwa àwọn ohun abẹ̀mí aláìfojúrí nínú èto ìpínká omi mímu ń ṣe àkóbá fún ìtọ́jú omi léyìí tó ń fa ìfasẹ́yì sí ìdára omi náà léyìí tó ń ṣe àkóbá fún aláfíà àgọ́ ara ènìyàn àti àwọn ẹranko.
Zulu: Ukuba khona kwama-microbiomes ayinkimbinkimbi ezinhlelweni zokusabalalisa amanzi okuphuza kuthinta ukusebenza kahle kokwelashwa okuholela emanzini asezingeni eliphansi okuthi ngenxa yalokho kuthinte impilo yabantu nezilwane.
Hausa: Kasancewar haɗaɗɗun ‘yan halitta a cikin tsarin rarraba ruwan sha yana shafar tasirin magani wanda yake haifar da rashin ingancin ruwa wanda a sakamakon haka yana shafar lafiyar ɗan’adam da kuma dabbobi.
Northern Sotho: Go ba gona ga diphedinyana tše di hlakahlakanego ka mananeong a kabo ya meetse a go nwewa go ama go šoma gabotse ga tlhwekišo ya ona gomme se se feletša ka meetse a boleng bjo bo fokolago gomme se ka morago se ama maphelo a batho le a diphoofolo.
Amharic: በመጠጥ ውሃ ስርጭት ስርዓቶች ውስጥ የተወሳሰቡ ማይክሮባዮሞች መኖራቸው የህክምናው ውጤታማነት ላይ ተጽእኖ በማሳደር ጥራቱ ደካማ ወደሆነ ውሃ ያመራል፤ በውጤቱም የሰው እና የእንስሳት ጤና ላይ ተጽእኖ ያሳድራል።

English: Drinking water treatment and distribution systems harbor various microbiota despite efforts made in improving water infrastructures and several waterborne diseases become serious problems in the water industry, specially, in developing Countries.
Luganda: Emiyungo gy’okulongoosa n’okutambuza amazzi gitereka obuwuka obutinniinya obw’enjawulo newankubadde nga kaweefube akoleddwa okufuba okulaba ng’emiyungo gy’amazzi girongoosebwa, endwadde ez’enjawulo eziva mu kukozesa amazzi amacaafu zifuuse ebizibu eby’amaanyi mu kitongole ky’amazzi, naddala mu mawanga agakyakula.
Yoruba: Ìtọ́jú omi mímu àti èto ìpínká rẹ̀ ń gba ọ̀pọ ohun abẹ̀mí aláiùfojúrí sára pẹ̀lú gbogbo ìlàkàkà tí a ṣe láti ri pé ìgbòòrò àwọn ẹ̀rọ ìgbómi dára àti pé ọ̀pọ àwọn àìsàn inú omí jẹ́ wàhálà ńlá níle iṣẹ́ àjọ omi, pàápàá, ní àwọn-orílè èdè tó ṣe ń rí ìdàgbàsókè.
Zulu: Izinhlelo zokuhlanza nokusabalalisa amanzi okuphuza zine-microbiota ehlukahlukene naphezu kwemizamo eyenziwe yokuthuthukisa ingqalasizinda yamanzi kanye nezifo eziningana ezibangelwa amanzi ziba izinkinga ezinkulu embonini yamanzi, ikakhulukazi, emazweni asathuthuka.
Hausa: Tsarin kula da ruwa da rarraba ruwan sha yana ɗauke da duk ‘yan halitta daban-daban duk da ƙoƙarin da ake yi wajen inganta abubuwan more rayuwa da kuma cututukan ruwa daban-daban da suke haifar matsaloli masu tsanani a masana'antar ruwa, musamman a ƙasashe masu tasowa.
Northern Sotho: Tlhwekišo ya meets ea go nwewa le mananeo a kabo ya meetse a ba le mehutahuta ya diphedinyana ka ntle le matsapa ao a dirwago go kaonafatša mananeokgoparara a meetse gomme malwetši a mmalwa a ka meetse a fetoga bothata bjo bogolo ka intastering ya meetse, kudukudu, ka dinageng tšeo di hlabologago.

English: Intermittent water supply, long-time of water storage, low water pressure in distribution systems, storage tankers and pipes as well as contaminated source water are among many of the factors responsible for low drinking water quality which in turn affecting health of people.
Luganda: Amazzi agabeerako akaseera obuseera mu lunaku ne gamala ne gagenda, okutereka amazzi okumala ebbanga eggwanvu, puleesa eya wansi mu miyungo egitambuza amazzi, ttanka ezitereka amazzi n’emidumu awamu n’amazzi amacaafu agali mu bifo abantu mwe baggya amazzi bye bimu ku bintu ebingi ebiviiriddeko omutindo ogwa wansi ogw’amazzi g’okunywa, bye tulaba nga bikosezza obulamu bw’abantu.
Yoruba: Ìṣekúmọkùmọ ìpínká omi, ìgúnlẹ̀ omi fún ọjọ́ pípẹ́, àìlágbára omi nínú èto ìpínká, àwọn ọkọ̀ agbómi pẹ̀lú ọ̀pá wọn àti àwọn orísun omi tó ti díbàjẹ́ wà lára ohun tó ń ṣokùnfa àmúye omi mímu tó dára léyìí tó ń gb ógun ti àgọ́ ara àwọn ènìyàn.

English: The aim of this study was to explore microbial diversity and structure in water samples collected from source water, treated water, reservoirs, and several household points of use locations (taps).
Luganda: Ekiruubirirwa ky’okunoonyereza kuno kyali kya kuzuula obuwuka obw’enjawulo n’ekikula kyabwo mu sampolo z’amazzi agaafunibwa mu bifo omuva amazzi, amazzi amalongoose, ebidiba, n’ebifo eby’enjawulo abantu mu maka mwe baggya amazzi (ku ttaapu ez’enjawulo).
Yoruba: Àfojúsùn ìwádìí yìí ni láti ṣe àyẹ̀wo ìyàtọ̀ àti ìkànpọ̀ àwọn ohun abẹ̀mí nínú àwọn àpẹẹrẹ omi tí a gbà áti orísun omi, omi tí a ti tọ́jú, gbùnǹgbùn ìgúnlẹ̀ omi, àti àwọn ojúlé tí a ti ń lò ó (ìdoòdò).
Zulu: Inhloso yalolu cwaningo bekuwukuhlola ukuhlukahluka kwe-microbial kanye nesakhiwo kumasampula amanzi aqoqwe emanzini omthombo, amanzi ahlanzekile, amachibi, kanye nezindawo ezimbalwa zasendlini zokusebenzisa (ompompi).
Hausa: Manufar wannan binciken shi ne domin a bincika bambance-bambancen ƙananan ƙwayoyin cuta da tsari a cikin samfuran ruwa da aka tattara daga ruwa mai tushe da ruwan da aka gyara da tafkuna, da wuraren amfani da gidaje da yawa (famfuna).
Northern Sotho: Maikemišetšo a dinyakišišo tše e bile go lekola phapano ya diphedinyana le sebopego sa tšona ka go disampole tša meetse tšeo di tšerwego go methopo ya meetse, go meetse ao a hlwekišitšwego, ka matamong, le ka mafelong a mmalwa a ka magaeng ao meetse a šomišwago gona (dithepe).
Amharic: የዚህ ጥናት ዓላማ ከውሃ መነሻ፣ ከተጣራ ውሃ፣ ከውሃ ማጠራቀሚያዎች እና ከበርካታ የቤት ውስጥ መጠቀሚያ ቦታዎች (ቧንቧዎች) በተሰበሰቡት የውሃ ናሙናዎች ውስጥ የሚገኙትን የረቂቅ ተህዋስያንን ልዩነት እና አወቃቀር መመርመር ነበር።

English: High throughput Illumina sequencing technology was employed by targeting V4 region of 16S rRNA following Illumina protocol to analyze the community structure of bacteria.
Luganda: Tekinologiya akozesebwa okwekaliriza endagabutonde mu bwangu yakozesebwa ku kitundu V4 eky’endagabutonde 16S rRNA okusinziira ku bintu eby’enjawulo ebyekuusa ku ndagabutonde okusobola okwekaliriza enkalira z’obuwuka.
Yoruba: Àwọn èrò ìjìnlẹ̀ ẹ̀rọ ajẹmọ́ iná jẹ́ lílò nípa fífojúsun àwọn agbègbe V4 ti 16S rRNA ní títẹ̀lé ìlànà ajẹmọ́ iná áti yànnàná àwùjọ ìkànpọ batéríà.
Zulu: Ubuchwepheshe bokulandelana kwe-Illumina be- throughput ephezulu buqashwe ngokukhomba isifunda se-V4 se-16S rRNA ngokulandela umthetho olandelwayo we-Illumina ukuze kuhlaziywe ukwakheka komphakathi kwamagciwane.
Hausa: An yi amfani da fasaha mai ƙima mai girma na Illumina ta hanyar niyya yankin V4 na ƙwayar gadon 16S rRNA bayan ƙa’idar Illumina don nazarin tsarin al’umma na ƙwayoyin cuta.
Northern Sotho: Theknolotši ya tšweletšo ya godimo ya tatelanyo ya Illumina e šomišitšwe ka go nepiša selete sa V4 sa 16S rRNA ka go latela tshepedišo ya Illumina go sekaseka sebopego sa sehlopha sa dipaktheria.
Amharic: ከፍተኛ ይዘት አሳላፊ ኢሉሚና የቅደም ተከተል ማስያዣ ቴክኖሎጂ የኢሉሚና ፕሮቶኮልን ተከትሎ የባክቴሪያዎችን ማህበረሰብ አወቃቀር ለመተንተን የ16S rRNAን V4 ክልል ላይ በማነጣጠር ስራ ላይ ውሏል።

English: The core dominating taxa were Proteobacteria followed by Firmicutes, Bacteroidetes and Actinobacteria.
Luganda: Ense z’obuwuka enkulu era ezaacaaka zaali obuwuka bwa Proteobacteria ne kuddako obuwuka bwa Firmicutes, Bacteroidetes n’obuwuka bwa Actinobacteria.
Yoruba: Ìpísísọ̀rín tó jẹ gàba ni Proteobacteria léyìí tí Firmicutes, Bacteroidetes àti Actinobacteria tẹ̀lé.
Zulu: I-taxa eyinhloko eyayibusa kwakuyi-Proteobacteria elandelwa yi-Firmicutes, i-Bacteroidetes ne-Actinobacteria.

English: Researchers in Ethiopia have found that some dangerous types of bacteria are able to survive in Addis Ababa’s tap water, even after the water has been treated with the chemical chlorine.

Northern Sotho: Ka dinageng tše ntši tšeo di hlabologago, batho ba sa hloka phihlelelo go meetse a go nwewa ao a bolokegilego.

Northern Sotho: Bothata bjo bo tlwaelegilego ke gore ditlhwekišo tša meetse, tša go swana le go tšhela tlelorine, ga di dirišwe gabotse.
Amharic: ክሎሪንን እንደመጠቀም ያሉ የውሃ ህክምናዎች በአግባቡ ጥቅም ላይ አለመዋላቸው የተለመደ ችግር ነው።

Yoruba: Nítorí náà, omi tó yẹ ní mímu lè di ibi tí àwọn ẹranko búburú lè ma bímọ sí kí wọ́n sì máa gbìnà yá.

English: To improve water quality, scientists need to have a thorough understanding of all the types of bacteria and other organisms present in the water, also called the water’s microbiota.
Luganda: Okusobola okutumbula omutindo gw’amazzi, bannassaayansi beetaaga okutegeerera ddala ebika by’obuwuka bwa bakitiiriya bwonna awamu n’obuwuka obulala obubeera mu mazzi, oluusi obuyitibwa obuwuka obutinniinya obw’omu mazzi.

Northern Sotho: Go kaonafatša boleng bja meetse, bašomi ba tša mahlale ba swanetše go ba le kwešišo ye kaone ya mehuta ya dipaktheria ka moka le ya diphedinyana tše dingwe tšeo di lego gona ka meetseng, tše gape di bitšwago diphedinyana tša ka meetseng.

English: In this study, the researchers wanted to understand how the microbiota changes as the water travels from treatment plants to storage tanks and eventually, to household taps.
Luganda: Mu kunoonyereza kuno, abanoonyereza baayagala okutegeera engeri obuwuka obutinniinya gye bukyukamu ng’amazzi gatambula okuva mu bifo mwe galongoosebwa ne gagenda mu ttanka mwe gaterekebwa, okutuukira ddala mu ttaapu ezisangibwa mu maka.

English: They were interested in which microorganisms could be found at different points in the water supply, and how abundant those organisms were.

Zulu: Babenesithakaselo sokuthi yiziphi izinto ezincane ezitholakala ezindaweni ezihlukene lapho kutholakala khona amanzi, nokuthi lezo zinambuzane zaziningi kangakanani.

English: The researchers studied the water in the Ethiopian city of Addis Ababa, where they collected 38 water samples from two water supply systems.

Zulu: Abacwaningi bacwaninga amanzi edolobheni lase-Ethiopia i-Addis Ababa, lapho baqoqa khona amasampula amanzi angama-38 ezinhlelweni ezimbili zokuhlinzeka ngamanzi.

Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba ile ba nyakišiša ka ga meetse ka toropokgolong ya Ethiopia ya Addis Ababa, fao ba ilego ba kgoboketša disampole tša meetse tše 38 go tšwa mananeong a kabo ya meetse a mabedi.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ በኢትዮጵያ አዲስ አበባ ከተማ በውሃ ላይ ጥናት ያደረጉ ሲሆን ከሁለት የውሃ አቅርቦት ስርዓቶች 38 የውሃ ናሙናዎችን ሰብስበዋል።

English: They tested water before and after it was treated at treatment plants, as well as  water stored in reservoirs for later use, and water coming from taps.
Luganda: Baakebera amazzi nga tegannateekebwamu ddagala n’oluvannyuma lw’okuteekebwamu eddagala mu bifo mwe galongoosebwa, awamu n’amazzi agaterekeddwa mu bidiba by’amazzi okukozesebwa mu biseera eby’omu maaso, ssaako amazzi agava mu ttaapu.
Yoruba: Wọ́n ṣe àyẹ̀wò omi ṣájú àti léyìn tí wọ́n ti ṣe ìtọ́jú rè ní ibi ìtọ́jú, àti béè náà omi tí a gbé pamọ́ sí ibi ìgbomipamọ́ sí fún ìlo ọjọ́ iwájú, àti omi tó ń ti ẹnu odò bọ̀.

Amharic: ውሃ በህክምና ጣቢያዎች ከመታከሙ በፊት እና በኋላ እንዲሁም በኋላ ጥቅም ላይ የሚውል በውሃ ማጠራቀሚያ ውስጥ የተከማቸ ውሃነን እና ከቧንቧ የሚመጣን ውሃ ፈትሸዋል።

English: The researchers then analysed the DNA in the samples, as DNA is present in all living organisms, including microorganisms like harmful bacteria.
Luganda: Oluvannyuma abanoonyereza beekaliriza endagabutonde eziri mu sampolo, kubanga endagabutonde zibeera mu buli kintu ekirina obulamu, nga n’obuwuka obutinniinya gamba ng’obuwuka bwa bakitiiriya obw’obulabe kw’obutadde.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí náà wá yánàná DNA nínú àwọn àpẹẹrẹ náà, bí DNA ṣe wà nínú gbogbo ohun abẹ̀mí, léyìí tí àwọn ohun abẹ̀mí kékèké bíi batéríà náà wà láàárín wọn.
Zulu: Abacwaningi babe sebehlaziya i-DNA kumasampula, njengoba i-DNA ikhona kuzo zonke izinto eziphilayo, okuhlanganisa nama-microorganisms afana namagciwane ayingozi.
Hausa: Daga nan ne masu binciken suka yi nazari a kan DNA a cikin samfuran, kamar yadda DNA yake nan a cikin dukkan halittu masu rai, gami da ƙananan ƙwayoyin cuta kamar ƙwayoyin cuta masu cutarwa.
Northern Sotho: Go tloga fao banyakišišio ba ile ba sekaseka DNA ka gare ga disampole, ka ge DNA e hwetšagala ka dipheding ka moka, go akaretšwa le ka diphedinyaneng tša go swana le dipaktheria tše kotsi.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ እንደ ጎጂ ባክቴሪያዎች ያሉ ረቂቅ ተህዋስያንን ጨምሮ ዲኤንኤ በሁሉም ህይወት ያላቸው ህዋሳት ውስጥ ስለሚገኝ በናሙናዎቹ ውስጥ ያለውን ዲኤንኤ ተንትነዋል።

English: Each organism’s DNA is a unique genetic code, so this approach allowed the researchers to quickly identify that many different types of microorganisms were part of the water’s microbiota.
Luganda: Endagabutonde ya buli kawuka ebeera koodi ya ndagabutonde ey’enjawulo, awo nno enkola eno yasobozesa abanoonyereza okuzuula amangu nti ebika by’obuwuka obutinniinya eby’enjawulo byali kitundu ku buwuka obutinniinya obw’omu mazzi.
Yoruba: Ọ̀kọ̀ọ̀kan DNA ohun abẹ̀mí ní kóòdù jẹ̀nẹ́tíìkì ìdámọ̀ tirẹ̀, nítorí náà ìlànà yìí fún àwọn aṣèwádìí ní àyè láti ṣe ìdámọ̀ pé ọ̀pọ irúfẹ́ àwọn ohun abẹ̀mí aláìfojúrí wa lára àwọn ohun abẹ̀mí kékèké inú omi.
Zulu: I-DNA yesidalwa ngasinye iyikhodi yofuzo eyingqayizivele, ngakho le ndlela yavumela abacwaningi ukuba babone ngokushesha ukuthi izinhlobo eziningi ze-microorganisms zaziyingxenye ye-microbiota yamanzi.
Hausa: DNA na kowane ƙwayoyin halitta wani nau’in ƙwayoyin gado ne na musamman, don haka, wannan tsarin ya ba wa masu bincike damar ganowa da sauri cewa nau'o'in ƙwayoyin halitta daban-daban sun kasance ɓangare na duk ‘yan halitta na ruwa.
Northern Sotho: DNA ya sephedinyana se sengwe le se sengwe ke khoute ya ditšini ya go swana e nnoši, ka fao mokgwa wo o ile wa dumelela banyakišiši go tseba ka pela gire mehuta ye mentši ye e fapafaopanego ya diphedinyana e bile karolo ya dipaktheria tša ka meetseng.
Amharic: የእያንዳንዱ ህዋስ ዲኤንኤ ልዩ የጄኔቲክ ኮድ ነው፣ ስለዚህ ይህ አቀራረብ ተመራማሪዎቹ ብዙ አይነት ረቂቅ ተህዋስያን የውሃው የረቂቅ ተህዋስያን ስብስብ አካል እንደነበሩ በፍጥነት እንዲያውቁ አስችሏቸዋል።

English: The researchers found that, in general, the further the water was from the treatment plant, the more different types of microorganisms were present.
Luganda: Okutwaliza awamu, abanoonyereza baazuula nti amazzi gye gaakoma okuva ewala n’ekifo mwe galongoosebwa, n’ebika by’obuwuka obutinniinya eby’enjawulo gye byakoma okusangibwa mu mazzi.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí náà ri pé, ni gbogbo ọ̀nà, bí omi náà ṣe jìnà sí ibi ìtọ́jú omi sí, náà ni oríṣi irúfẹ́ àwọn ohun abẹ̀mí kékèké náà ṣe wà níbẹ̀.
Zulu: Abacwaningi bathola ukuthi, ngokuvamile, lapho amanzi eqhubeka ephuma esitshalweni sokwelapha, izinhlobo ezihlukahlukene ze-microorganisms zazikhona.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun gano cewa, gabaɗaya, yadda ruwan ya kasance daga cibiyoyin tsabtace ruwa, haka nan yawancin nau’o’in ƙwayoyin cuta daban-daban suna kasancewa.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba utollotše gore, ka kakaretšo, ge meetse a be a le kgole pholante ya tlhwekišo, go be go eba le mehuta ya diphedinyana ka go ona.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ በአጠቃላይ ውሃው ከህክምና ጣቢያው የበለጠ እየራቀ በሄደ መጠን የበለጠ የተለያዩ አይነት ረቂቅ ተህዋስያን እንደሚገኙ ደርሰውበታል።

English: They also noticed that the types of microorganisms that were most common were often different depending on where in the system the water was collected.
Luganda: Mu ngeri endala era baazuula nti ebika by’obuwuka obutinniinya obwasinga okuzuulibwa byatera okuba eby’enjawulo okusinziira ku kifo amazzi we gaggyibwa mu muyungo ogwo.
Yoruba: Wọ́n tún ṣe àkíyèsí pé irúfẹ́ ẹ̀ya àwọn ohun abẹ̀mí kékèké tó gbajúmọ̀ jùlọ máa ń yàtọ̀ ní ìbámu pẹ̀lú ibi tí a ti gba omi náà.
Zulu: Baphinde baqaphela ukuthi izinhlobo zama-microorganisms ezivame kakhulu zazivame ukuhluka kuye ngokuthi lapho amanzi aqoqwe kuphi ohlelweni.
Hausa: Har wa yau, sun lura cewa nau'o'in ƙananan ƙwayoyin cuta da suka fi yawa sun bambanta dangane da inda a cikin tsarin da aka tara ruwa.
Northern Sotho: Ba ile ba lemoga gape gore mehuta ya diphedinyana yeo e bego e tlwaelegilego kudu e be e fapane gantši go eya ka gore meetse a tšerwe kae ka fao lenaneong la meetse.
Amharic: በተጨማሪም በጣም የተለመዱት ረቂቅ ተህዋስያን አይነቶች አብዛኛውን ጊዜ በስርዓቱ ውስጥ ውሃ በሚወሰድበት ቦታ ላይ በመመስረት የተለያዩ መሆናቸውን አስተውለዋል።

English: For example, some types of bacteria that could potentially cause diseases in humans were present in higher numbers in water from taps and other sources further away from the treatment plant.
Luganda: Okugeza, ebika by’obuwuka bwa bakitiiriya ebimu ebisobola okuleeta endwadde mu bantu bwali bungi nnyo mu mazzi g’omu ttaapu n’ago agava mu bifo ebirala ebiri ewala ennyo n’ekifo mwe galongoosebwa.
Yoruba: Fún àpẹẹrẹ, irúfẹ́ àwọn batéríà tí ó lè fa àìsàn nínú ènìyàn wà janturu nínú omi láti ẹnu ìdoodò àti àwọn orísun miíràn tó jìnà sí ibùdó ìtọ́jú.
Zulu: Isibonelo, ezinye izinhlobo zamabhaktheriya ezingase zibangele izifo kubantu zazikhona ngamanani aphezulu emanzini aphuma kompompi neminye imithombo ekude nendawo yokwelapha.
Hausa: Misali, wasu nau’o’in ƙwayoyin cuta da za su iya haifar da cututtuka a cikin mutane sun kasance a cikin ruwa mai yawa daga famfuna da sauran hanyoyin nesa da cibiyoyin tsabtace ruwa.
Northern Sotho: Go fa mohlala, mehuta ye mengwe ya dipaktheria yeo go nago le kgonagalo ya gore e ka baka malwetši go batho e be e le gona ka palo ya godingwana ka meetseng go tšwa dithepeng le go methopo ye mengwe ye e legho kgole le pholante ya tlhwekišo ya meetse.
Amharic: ለምሳሌ፣ በሰዎች ላይ በሽታ ሊያስከትሉ የሚችሉ አንዳንድ የባክቴሪያ አይነቶች ከቧንቧ እና ከህክምና ጣቢያው ርቀው ከሚገኙ ሌሎች መነሻዎች ውሃ ውስጥ በከፍተኛ ቁጥር ተገኝተዋል።

English: They said that possible reasons for the increase in dangerous bacteria include too little chlorine in the water after treatment, and possible breakdowns or leaks in pipes that could lead to contamination.
Luganda: Baagamba nti ezimu ku nsonga eziyinza okuba nga ze ziviiriddeko obuwuka bwa bakitiiriya obw’omutawaana mulimu okuteeka kuloliini omutono ennyo mu mazzi nga gamaze okulongoosebwa, emidumu egiyinza okwabika oba okutonnya ne giviirako amazzi okwonooneka.
Yoruba: Wọ́n sọ pé àwọn ohun tó lè fa ìpọ̀si batéríà burúkú náà ni kiloríìni kékeré nínú omi lẹ́yìn ìtọ́jú, àti àwọn ìdaṣẹ́lẹ̀ tàbí ìjò ọ̀pá agbómi tó lè yorí sí ìkóràn.
Zulu: Bathe okungase kube yizizathu zokwanda kwamagciwane ayingozi kubalwa i-chlorine encane kakhulu emanzini ngemva kokwelashwa, nokuphuka okungenzeka noma ukuvuza kwamapayipi okungaholela ekungcoleni.
Hausa: Sun ce dalilan da za su iya haifar da ƙaruwar ƙwayoyin cutar da suke da haɗari sun haɗa da sinadarin chlorine da ya yi kaɗan a cikin ruwa bayan an sa magani, da kuma yiwuwar karyewa ko ɓulewar bututun da zai iya haifar da gurɓacewa.
Northern Sotho: Ba boletše gore maaka ao a kgonagalago a koketšego ya dipaktheria tše kotsi a akaretša tlelorine ye nnyane kudu ka meetse ka morago ga go a hlwekiša, le kgonagalo ya go phulega goba ya go dutla ga diphaepe fao go ka feletšago ka tšhilafatšo.
Amharic: ለአደገኛ ባክቴሪያዎች ከመጨመር ምክንያቶች ውስጥ ከህክምና በኋላ በውሃ ውስጥ ያለው ክሎሪን በጣም ትንሽ መሆን፣ ወደ ብክለት ሊያመራ የሚችል የቧንቧዎች ብልሽት ወይም የውሃ መፍሰስን ሊያክሉ እንደሚችሉ ተናግረዋል።

English: They added that some dangerous bacteria are also resistant to chlorine, and that these bacteria may be able to survive and breed in the water system despite treatment.
Luganda: Baayongerako ne bagamba nti obuwuka bwa bakitiiriya obumu eddagala lya kuloliini teributta, era nti obuwuka bwa bakitiiriya buno buyinza okusigala nga bulamu ne bwalulira mu muyungo gw’amazzi newankubadde nga gateekeddwamu eddagala.
Yoruba: Wọ́n fi kun pé àwo batéríà burúkú kán wà tí kiloríìni ò kápá, àti pé àwọn bateríà wọ̀nyí lè yè kí wọ́n sì bímọ nínú omi lkódà lẹ́yìn ìtọ́jú omi náà.
Zulu: Bengeze ngokuthi amanye amagciwane ayingozi awakwazi ukumelana ne-chlorine, nokuthi la magciwane angase akwazi ukuphila futhi azalele emanzini naphezu kokwelashwa.
Hausa: Sun ƙara da cewa wasu ƙwayoyin cuta masu haɗarin gaske su ma suna da juriya ga sinadarin chlorine, kuma waɗannan ƙwayoyin za su iya rayuwa su hayayyafa a cikin tsarin ruwa duk da magani.
Northern Sotho: Ba ile ba tlaleletša ka gore dipaktheria tše kotsi le tšona di palelwa ke go bolawa ke tlelorine, le gore dipaktheria tše di ka kgona go phela le go ikoketša ka lenaneong meetse le ge meetse ao a hlwekišitšwe.
Amharic: አንዳንድ አደገኛ ባክቴሪያዎች ክሎሪንን የመቋቋም አቅም እንዳላቸው እና እነዚህ ባክቴሪያዎች ህክምና ቢደረግላቸውም በውሃ ስርዓት ውስጥ ሊኖሩ እና ሊራቡ እንደሚችሉ አክለዋል።

English: These microorganisms can then cause infections in humans, and some may cause diseases like diarrhoea.
Luganda: Obuwuka obutinniinya obw’ekika kino olwo busobola okuleetera abantu obuwuka, ate obumu busobola n’okuleeta endwadde gamba ng’embiro.
Yoruba: Àwọn ohun abẹ̀mí kékèké yìí lè fa àìsàn nínú enìyàn, bẹ́ẹ̀ àwọn mìíràn lè fa ìgbẹ́ gbuuru.
Zulu: Lawa ma-microorganisms angabangela izifo kubantu, kanti amanye angabangela izifo ezifana nesifo sohudo.
Hausa: Waɗannan ƙwayoyin halitta suna iya haifar da cututtuka a cikin mutane, kuma wasu suna iya haifar da cututtuka kamar gudawa.
Northern Sotho: Diphedinyana tše go tloga fao di ka baka diphetetšo go batho, gomme tše dingwe di ka baka malwetši a go swana le letšhologo.
Amharic: እነዚህ ረቂቅ ተህዋስያን በሰዎች ላይ ኢንፌክሽን ሊያስከትሉ ይችላሉ እንዲሁም አንዳንዶቹ እንደ ተቅማጥ ያሉ በሽታዎችን ሊያስከትሉ ይችላሉ።

English: The researchers said that this is the first study to investigate microbiota at different points in the water system in Addis Ababa using a special DNA sequencing technique called  “MiSeq”.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza baagamba nti kuno kwe kunoonyereza okusaale okunoonyereza ku buwuka obutinniinya mu bifo eby’enjawulo ebiri mu muyungo gw’amazzi mu kibuga Addis Ababa nga kukozesa enkola y’okusengeka endagabutonde eyitibwa “MiSeq”.
Yoruba: Àwọn olùṣèwádìí náà sọ pé eyí ni ìwádìí àkọ́kọ́ tó ń ṣèwádìí ohun abẹ̀mí aláìfojúrí ní ọ̀gangan oríṣiríṣìí nínú ètò omi ní Addis Ababa nípa lílo ète ṣíṣẹ̀-n-tẹ̀lé DNA tí tí a pè ní “MiSeq”.
Zulu: Abacwaningi bathi lokhu kuyisifundo sokuqala sokuphenya i-microbiota ezindaweni ezihlukene ohlelweni lwamanzi e-Addis Ababa kusetshenziswa indlela ekhethekile yokulandelana kwe-DNA ebizwa ngokuthi "i-MiSeq".
Hausa: Masu binciken sun ce wannan shi ne bincike na farko da aka gudanar da bincike kan duk ‘yan halitta a wurare daban-daban a cikin tsarin ruwa a Addis Ababa ta hanyar amfani da wata dabara ta musamman ta jerin DNA da ake kira "MiSeq".
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba boletše gore tše ke dinyakišišo tša mathomo tša go nyakišiša dipaktheria ka mafelong ao a fapafapoanego ka lenaneong la meetse ka Addis Ababa ka go šomiša mokgwa wo o kgethegilego wa go latelanya DNA wo o bitšwago “MiSeq”.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ በአዲስ አበባ የውሃ ስርዓት ውስጥ በተለያዩ ቦታዎች የረቂቅ ተህዋስያን ስብስብ ጥናት “ሚሴክ” በተባለ ልዩ የዲኤንኤ ቅደም ተከተል ማስያዝ ቴክኒክን በመጠቀም ለመመርመር የመጀመሪያው ነው ብለዋል።

English: Their analysis showed that many different organisms make up the microbiota, and that these organisms change throughout the water distribution system.
Luganda: Okwekaliriza kwabwe kwalaga nti obuwuka bungi obw’enjawulo obukola omugatte gw’obuwuka obutinniinya, era nti obuwuka buno bukyukakyuka okwetooloola omuyungo gw’okutambuza amazzi.
Yoruba: Àwọn ìtúpalẹ̀ wọ́n fi hàn pé ọ̀pọ̀lọpọ̀ àwọn ohun abẹ̀mí yìí ni wọ́n parapọ̀ di ohun abẹ̀mí aláìfojúrí, àti pé àwọn ohun abẹ̀mí wọ̀nyí máa ń yí padà nínú ètò ipínká omi.
Zulu: Ukuhlaziya kwabo kwabonisa ukuthi izinto eziningi eziphilayo ezihlukene zakha i-microbiota, nokuthi lezi zinto eziphilayo ziyashintsha kulo lonke uhlelo lokusabalalisa amanzi.
Hausa: Bincikensu ya nuna cewa halittu daban-daban sun haɗa da duk ‘yan halitta, kuma waɗannan ƙwayoyin suna canzawa a cikin tsarin rarraba ruwa.
Northern Sotho: Tshekatsheko ya bona e bontšhitše gore diphedinyana tše ntši tše di fapafapanego di bopa dipaktheria tše nnyane, le gore diphedinyuana tše di a fetoga ka lenaneong ka moka la kabo ya meetse.
Amharic: የእነርሱ ትንታኔ እንደሚያሳየው ብዙ የተለያዩ ህዋሳት የረቂቅ ተህዋስያን የስብስብ አካል እንደሆኑ እና እነዚህም ህዋሳት በመላው የውሃ ስርጭት ስርዓት ውስጥ ይቀየራሉ።

English: The researchers cautioned that the “MiSeq” technique didn’t allow them to identify the exact species of microorganisms in each water sample.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza baalabula nti enkola ya “MiSeq” teyabasobozesa kuzuula bika bya buwuka obutinniinya bwennyini obwali mu buli sampolo y’amazzi.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí náà kìlọ̀ pé ète “MiSeq” náà ò jẹ́ kí wọ́n ṣe ìdámọ̀ irúfẹ́ àwọn ohun abẹ̀mí aláìfojúrí kan nínú àpẹẹrẹ omi.
Zulu: Abacwaningi baxwayise ngokuthi indlela ye-“MiSeq” ayizange ibavumele ukuthi bakhombe uhlobo oluqondile lwama-microorganisms kusampula ngayinye yamanzi.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun yi gargaɗin cewa dabarar "MiSeq" ba ta ba su damar gano ainihin nau’o’in ƙwayoyin halitta a cikin kowane samfurin ruwa ba.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba ile ba lemoša gore mokgwa wa “MiSeq” ga se wa ba dumelela go hlatha mohuta wo itšego wa diphedinyana ka sampoleng ye nngwe le ye nngwe ya meetse.
